body_edits.diff: I am not sure how many frameworks really support strict XML/JSON schema validation without hassle. Sounds like the sort of thing you would need an API gateway or WAF to do easily. I assume that other controls would cover the need for validation of the values within the schema so I would consider raising this to L2 or L3.

> Verify that XML or JSON schema is in place and verified before accepting input.	


I am not sure how many frameworks really support strict XML/JSON schema validation without hassle. Sounds like the sort of thing you would need an API gateway or WAF to do easily. I assume that other controls would cover the need for validation of the values within the schema so I would consider raising this to L2 or L3.

> Verify that XML or JSON schema is in place and verified before accepting input.	


I am not sure how many frameworks really support strict XML/JSON schema validation without hassle. Sounds like the sort of thing you would need an API gateway or WAF to do easily. I assume that other controls (e.g. 18.5) would cover the need for validation of the values within the schema so I would consider raising this to L2 or L3.
